ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.18.3.1 is a regression-rollback playtest for RimWorld 1.5. Runtime evidence from V0.4.18.3 showed that the frame-budgeted ReachProfile capture pump greatly increased cold profile misses and exposed live Vanilla Reachability/RegionTraverser again, causing a severe JobGiver performance regression. V0.4.18.3.1 restores the V0.4.18.2/V0.4.16 synchronous ReachProfile capture path with sampled positive and negative authority, per-profile cooldown and the global parity fuse. The V0.4.18.3 stable-spatial GenClosest consumer is disabled after its first sample produced signature reuse but zero accelerated calls. The low-yield identity-keyed async candidate plan and zero-yield RegionHint remain retired. Broad/JobGiver nearest ordering, WorkPrefilter, haul accelerators and shadow-only path telemetry remain active. Workers do not create Jobs, reserve targets, or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map/Unity state.
